main_text.head: AD LECTOREM, Samuelis Holtzachij Basiliensis Carmen.

p.i: Tempora percurrunt haec scripta volubilis anni, Et quædam certis gesta diebus habent. Hæc quoq; divino referēte Melanchthone scripsit, Plurima quæ solitæ pondera laudis habent. Cũ sint grata scholis dixit quæcunq; Melãchthon: Vana quid ulterius fundere verba juvat?

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side (faint title text at top and the neighbouring page's margin text at the right edge) is not transcribed. Verse lines are kept within one paragraph as one stanza. The abbreviations cũ, q; and Melãchthon are kept as printed.
